methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/plans page on the accessed date; cloud-backup vendors typically headline an annual price, so the per-month USD figure is the published annual rate divided by 12 (the annual rate and any first-year/renewal split are stated in notes). Where the official page rendered EUR/GBP or blocked direct access, the USD figures were corroborated against a provider support page or a dedicated 2026 pricing-review source recorded as corroboration; per-user/per-device tiers carry the per-seat USD price with billingModel per_seat and a note, and quote-only tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. HIPAA/BAA are null except where the provider explicitly markets compliance, annualDiscountPct is recorded only where a separate annual rate is published, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.

plans.name: Personal Backup
plans.notes: Unlimited backup for one computer (and attached external drives), continuous automated backup, dedicated restore app, web restores up to 500 GB per request, free mailed-drive restores, private-key encryption and 2FA. Billed $99/year (the page shows the annual rate; forever version history is an added fee).

plans.name: Business Backup
plans.notes: Everything in Personal per computer plus multi-user management, centralized web admin, MSI/JAMF/Munki deployment, centralized billing and SSO via Google and Microsoft. Billed $99/year per computer.

plans.name: Enterprise Control
plans.notes: Everything in Business plus advanced support, enhanced backup lockdowns, OIDC SSO (Okta, Azure AD) and restricted restore access. Custom pricing - listed as Contact us, so no published self-serve price.

plans.name: Mini 100 GB
plans.notes: 100 GB for a single user across multiple devices; billed $3/year. Standard pricing applies after the first year.

plans.name: Mini 500 GB
plans.notes: 500 GB for a single user across multiple devices; billed $9.96/year. Standard pricing applies after the first year.

plans.name: Personal 5 TB
plans.notes: 5 TB for one user across an unlimited number of computers and mobile devices. Introductory $83.88 first year, then $119.88/year standard (the page shows the $6.99/mo equivalent).

plans.name: Personal 10 TB
plans.notes: 10 TB for one user across unlimited devices. Introductory $125.88 first year, then $179.88/year standard.

plans.name: Personal 20 TB
plans.notes: 20 TB for one user across unlimited devices. Introductory $209.88 first year, then $299.88/year standard.

plans.name: Personal 50 TB
plans.notes: 50 TB for one user across unlimited devices. Introductory $419.88 first year, then $599.88/year standard.

plans.name: Personal 100 TB
plans.notes: 100 TB for one user across unlimited devices. Introductory $839.88 first year, then $1,199.88/year standard.

plans.name: Business 500 GB
plans.notes: 500 GB shared across unlimited users, servers, Exchange, SQL and NAS devices. Introductory $167.88 first year, then $239.88/year standard.

plans.name: Business 1.25 TB
plans.notes: 1.25 TB shared across unlimited users, servers and devices. Introductory $419.88 first year, then $599.88/year standard.

plans.name: Business 2.5 TB
plans.notes: 2.5 TB shared across unlimited users, servers and devices. Introductory $671.88 first year, then $959.88/year standard.

plans.name: Carbonite Safe
plans.notes: Automatic unlimited cloud backup for one computer, remote file access, optional external-drive backup, 128-bit encryption and award-winning support. Billed $95.99/year (the page shows the annual rate).

plans.name: Carbonite Safe Pro
plans.notes: Everything in Safe plus centralized management and admin controls and support for regulated industries (FERPA, GLBA, HIPAA). Billed $287.99/year.

plans.name: Carbonite Safe Server Backup
plans.notes: Server-class backup tier covering databases and live applications for larger deployments. Billed $599.99/year.

vendors.name: CrashPlan
vendors.provenance: https://smb.crashplan.com/smb-pricing/ (official CrashPlan for Small Business self-serve pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; CrashPlan exited the consumer market and sells per-seat business backup, with 250+ employee organizations directed to a custom quote)

plans.name: Endpoints (SMB)
plans.notes: Per-user endpoint backup with unlimited cloud storage and unlimited versioning across Windows, Mac and Linux, automatic backups and self-service restore/device migration. $8/user/month, or $88/user/year (~8% off), or $158/user for 2 years; applies to organizations up to 249 employees.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 (SMB)
plans.notes: Per-user backup and recovery for Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive with full-text indexing for search/eDiscovery; 50 GB pooled cloud storage per user, extra capacity $7.50/month per 250 GB. $4/user/month, or $44/user/year (~8% off), or $79/user for 2 years.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Endpoint, server and Microsoft 365/Google Workspace backup for organizations with 250+ employees. Quote-only - the enterprise page lists only a Get a Quote call to action, so no published self-serve price.

vendors.name: SpiderOak One Backup
vendors.provenance: https://spideroak.support/hc/en-us/articles/115002048046-ONE-Pricing (official SpiderOak support pricing article, accessed 2026-06-13; the main spideroak.com pricing path was not directly fetchable)

plans.name: 150 GB
plans.notes: 150 GB of end-to-end-encrypted backup across an unlimited number of devices with full feature access (sharing, deduplication, no extra access fees). $6/month or $69/year (~4% off).

plans.name: 400 GB
plans.notes: 400 GB across unlimited devices with full feature access. $11/month or $115/year (~13% off).

plans.name: 2 TB
plans.notes: 2 TB across unlimited devices with full feature access. $14/month or $149/year (~11% off).

plans.name: 5 TB
plans.notes: 5 TB across unlimited devices with full feature access. $29/month or $320/year (~8% off).

vendors.name: pCloud
vendors.provenance: https://www.pcloud.com/cloud-storage-pricing-plans.html (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page geolocated to EUR, so the US monthly/annual USD figures were corroborated via Gizmodo's 2026 pcloud pricing breakdown)

plans.name: Premium 500 GB
plans.notes: 500 GB of storage with full backup/sync features for one user. $4.99/month or $49.99/year (~17% off); also sold as a $199 one-time lifetime plan on the pricing page.

plans.name: Premium Plus 2 TB
plans.notes: 2 TB of storage with full backup/sync features for one user; the page headlines the annual rate of $99.99/year (the $8.33/mo equivalent). Also sold as a $399 one-time lifetime plan.

plans.name: Ultra 10 TB
plans.notes: 10 TB of storage for one user, listed on the pricing page only as a $1,190 one-time lifetime plan (EUR1190 on the geolocated page); no monthly/annual subscription rate is published for this tier, so monthlyUsd is null.

vendors.name: Acronis True Image
vendors.provenance: https://www.acronis.com/en-us/products/true-image/buy/ (official buy page, accessed 2026-06-13 but returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch / bot-protected); 1-year USD prices and storage tiers corroborated via StackScored's 2026 Acronis True Image pricing breakdown and confirmed across TrustRadius and the official-site search snippet

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Local backup, disk cloning and basic ransomware protection for 1 computer; no cloud storage included. Billed $49.99/year (the $4.17/mo equivalent).

plans.name: Advanced (1 device)
plans.notes: Local plus cloud backup with 500 GB of cloud storage, anti-malware protection and VPN for 1 computer. Billed $54.99/year; 3-device $79.99/year and 5-device $99.99/year are also offered.

plans.name: Premium (1 device)
plans.notes: Comprehensive protection with 1 TB of cloud storage, anti-malware, blockchain-based notarization and electronic signing for 1 computer. Billed $124.99/year; 3-device $174.99/year and 5-device $199.99/year (the 5-device tier scales cloud storage up to 10 TB) are also offered.

vendors.name: Jottacloud
vendors.provenance: https://www.jottacloud.com/en/pricing.html (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page geolocated to EUR, so the published US monthly USD figures were corroborated via Jottacloud's 2026 pricing summary/reviews)

plans.name: Personal (Free)
plans.notes: 5 GB of free backup storage for a single user.

plans.name: Home 1 TB
plans.notes: 1 TB of backup storage shared across up to 5 users. $6.99/month (EUR6.90 on the geolocated official page); annual $69.90/year. USD rate confirmed on Cloudwards' 2026 Jottacloud review.

plans.name: Personal Unlimited
plans.notes: Unlimited backup storage for one user (upload speed reduced after 5 TB). $11.99/month (EUR11.90 on the geolocated official page); annual $119.90/year. USD rate confirmed on Cloudwards' 2026 Jottacloud review.

plans.name: Home 5 TB
plans.notes: 5 TB of backup storage shared across up to 5 users. $15.99/month (EUR14.90/month, EUR149/year on the geolocated official page); annual $159.90/year. USD rate confirmed on Cloudwards' 2026 Jottacloud review.
